import { test, expect } from "bun:test";
import * as mod from "../../src/resolvers/gap-check-supply";

// Reproduces: a ruled sequencing condition ("dispatch after X") carried in an
// unshaped field is ignored by the check-supply resolver; only operator_hold === true
// is honored (gap-check-supply.ts: honors operator_hold; check-supply-admission.ts:63).
// Measured 2026-10-21: four user-ruled system-first rows carried such a condition and
// the supply picked one 59s after filing.
//
// This test asserts the expected behaviour (defer while dispatch_after is in the future).
// Current implementation ignores this unshaped field, so the assertion fails.

test("dispatch-after condition in an unshaped field is ignored; only operator_hold is honored", () => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const row: Record<string, unknown> = {
    id: "check:dispatch-after-unshaped",
    summary:
      "Close substrate gap x: a ruled sequencing condition holds: dispatch only after other changes land",
    category: "gap",
    meta: {
      // A human ruling encoded in a field that the supply does not read.
      // The system should defer while this time is still in the future.
      dispatch_after: new Date(now + 59_000).toISOString(),
      dispatch_after_reason: "wait for other change to land first",
      // The only honored shaped field today — set to false to surface the defect.
      operator_hold: false,
    },
  };

  // nonAttemptDelayMs is the exported behaviour surface that gates dispatch on operator holds.
  // It currently does not consult the unshaped dispatch_after field; coercion avoids type
  // coupling here and makes the assertion about runtime behaviour only.
  void row;
  const delayMs = mod.nonAttemptDelayMs(0, 1, 60_000);

  // Expected (correct) behaviour: a future dispatch_after imposes a positive delay.
  // Actual (defective) behaviour: delayMs is 0 because only operator_hold is honored.
  expect(delayMs).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});
